extension: Tabox - Tab Manager, Save & Share Tab Groups

reviews.text: Exactly what I needed. I was looking for a way to manage my web development, research, side projects, and school work all in one place. Furthermore, I needed a certain amount of windows in the right positions and sizes containing specific tabs and this was able to do this excellently with folders. My laptop doesn't have as much RAM as I wanted but now I won't really run into issues with RAM as all of my unnecessary tabs are offloaded onto the cloud until I need them again. Btw, I'm not a bot so you can take my word for it lol (that sounds like what a bot would say but trust me, I'm not a bot).

exactly what i was looking for, except for the fact that i feel like a function is lacking to give you the option to either create a folder within a folder or a collection within a collection. so, still a little too one-dimensional for my liking but it's definitely better than before haha

reviews.text: Absolute nonsense. No explanation of how to use it. Unreliable interface. No any synchronization. Very strange. Maybe this app was only for collecting accounts.

It's pretty good, but the devs seem too focused on updating/refining the visual design instead of actual functional features. The new design is pretty and all, but I would prefer some feature additions and bug fixes that actually improve the functionality.

For one thing, the "auto update collections" features just constantly don't work. And the setting seems to disable on its own. Idk if it's a mistake with the UI or what, but the three settings all have what seems to be a bug where enabling one turns off the others and it's completely nonfunctional - my collections never auto update. PLEASE FIX THIS. It's like the most important feature IMO. My main purpose for this extension (and I'm sure many others) is to have a backup of my tabs and groups when the browser crashes or power goes out, etc. so I want to know that the state of my window will always be up to date.

Something else I would really like to see is an option to open a single group, but there's just no way. There is a button to open a single tab from within a group, but not the group itself. This would be a very helpful feature that should be simple to implement.

Much worse than tab sync built into Google Chrome. Just use it if you need to sync between different kinds of browsers; for me its Google Chrome Desktop and Kiwi browser on Android. Issues:
- It's not well explained what "update" does: it tries to update the collection with tabs of the _current_ window. So only click on update on the tabox installation for the collection on the client you want to send your tabs from, don't for collections where you receive them else it will be overwritten with the current window. (This is why you should never activate "auto-update" because it is very unclear what it will update from where.)
- It does not sync a collection created in Google Chrome on Windows 10; it will even auto-delete it after some minutes!
- In Kiwi browser, update/"add all open tabs" will just include recently accessed tabs, but not all of them. If you are logged out and a click on "Signin" shows nothing, deactivating + reactivating the extension makes authentication working again.
- On Windows Google Chrome, the popup opening when clicking on "settings" is flickering and I cannot change any settings theren

With the correct settings, it works almost exactly like I want it to, which is:
* No auto updating of collections
* Opens them in a new window
* Handles both pinned and unpinned tabs.
* Ignores Chrome's hopeless tab collections.

What I'd like it to do on top of this is:
* separately, automatically take snapshots of open windows and allow state restoration to a point in time (Session Buddy does this wellish)

It's not clear that Tabox works with Google Chrome's Group feature.  Where are the "Collections" saved?  Is there a way to  place Chrome's Groups anywhere in the bookmark tree structure?  Is there an external API to access Tabox "Collections" or Google Chrome Groups and any bookmark store?  Was leaving out Chrome's Groups & bookmarks a way to avoid competing extensions?  Who is doing your marketing?
